note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Dial, telemeter ring and the strap leather come from one photo map.

case.note: (r, z): brushed case flank and the low band outside the bezel (20.1-21 mm in the photo) that carries the crown and pushers

bezel.note: (r, z): polished sloped bezel ring (19.5-20.15 mm in this photo); inner lip covers the dial edge

hand_white.note: white chronograph needle and sub-dial hands as photographed

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission; black base colour so the black dial is not hazed in model-viewer

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL 1K; lines along the lugs (model Y); bevels keep the polished material

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (23.4 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius
